title: COPA: A Congestion-Oriented Pin Assignment Framework for Intra-Block Physical Design Optimization
extraction_scope: Institutional abstract, title, seven authors and DOI; author-lab listing confirms conference identity. No full manuscript located on lab page.
mechanism: Gradient-based adjustment of feedthrough-pin positions using a routing-demand congestion objective.
limits: Overflow reduction is not proof of timing closure or final detailed-routing success. Headline percentages withheld pending testcase, capacity and baseline conditions; no full-text or independent acceptance.
Wirelength preservation is an abstract-level claim, not a verified constraint across named testcases.
next_action: Original abstract and conservative coding integrated; recover full paper to inspect objective, legality constraints, routing stage and equal-budget comparisons.
